column1: # The source code of every part of the APK under the GPL or LGPL, as archives to put next to the APK in each release. THIRD_PARTY.md lists the parts.
#   python3 -I tools/fetch-sources.py           download into dist/sources/, check each SHA-256
#   python3 -I tools/fetch-sources.py --record  the same, and write the SHA-256 of what came
# Columns, tab-separated: file (as attached to the release), what it is the source of, licence,
# URL, SHA-256 (left out until --record), and optionally the only folders to keep: the archive is
# then repacked with just those (the SHA-256 is of the repacked file). Parts under MIT and similar
# licences (Box64, Mesa) need no source next to the APK: THIRD_PARTY.md links them. Versions are read from the files in the APK; where the
# exact commit is not published, the note in the second column says what was chosen and why.
# Winlator and the parts its author builds (the last commit before Winlator 11.2, 14 Nov 2026)
